volunteerExperiences.description:
- Volunteered annually at this summer event to support fundraising efforts for the Church, contributing to dedicated and strenuous work through various conditions
- Enhanced flexibility and timeliness by adapting to rigorous conditions, demonstrating the ability to adjust to high demands

- Assisted children with disabilities in safely participating in indoor rock-climbing activities

projects.title: Automated Software Design Tool
projects.description:
- Built a human-in-the-loop LLM design tool with a team of 5 that converts a plain-language project description into a structured design system that includes requirements, use cases, domain model, sequence diagrams, and a design class diagram, with edit/approve checkpoints at every stage.
- Engineered a modular, step-by-step pipeline to keep developers in control, reduce cascading errors, and set up reliable code generation from finalized design artifacts

projects.title: Peer Review Electronic Management (PREM) App | Appian
projects.description:
- Developed an application to streamline the peer review process, including submission, multi-stage approval, revision workflows, and status tracking using Appian’s process modeling tools
- Designed user-friendly dashboards, dynamic forms, and logic-based visibility using Appian's record types, interfaces, and rules
- Enabled real-time status tracking and comment-based collaboration to support transparent, efficient peer evaluations
